in_marathi.name: वैभव
in_marathi.long_meaning: वैभव हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name वैभव is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘वैभव’, which means ‘prosperity’, ‘wealth’, or ‘fortune’. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with the god Vishnu, who is believed to bestow wealth, prosperity, and abundance upon his devotees. The name is often given to children as a blessing for a prosperous and successful future.
